@copilot Update this PR directly to fix one regression introduced by the new write to the unwrapped connection's DbInfo cache. The latest Copilot review, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20941#pullrequestreview-5639460992, reports a substantive body-only finding: an outer decorating driver's unrecognized URL can overwrite valid metadata already captured from the underlying driver.

The concrete example is OpenTelemetryDriver with jdbc:otel:mysql://host/shop. OpenTelemetryDriver.connect strips jdbc:otel: to jdbc: before calling the real driver's connect, which caches recognized MySQL metadata. It returns an OpenTelemetryConnection whose unwrap(Connection.class) delegates to that real connection. Our parser does not currently recognize jdbc:otel:, so the new propagation in DriverInstrumentation.addDbInfo can then overwrite the delegate's correct metadata with other_sql and no namespace. Source inspection confirms these call paths. This regression is directly caused by the PR's generic cache propagation and is in scope.

Reproduce this overwrite with focused automated coverage under javaagent instrumentation, then make a surgical correction so an unrecognized decorating-driver URL does not clobber valid delegate metadata. Select the simplest repository-consistent fix after reproducing the actual behavior. Preserve the original MySQL replication fix: both source/replica routing and configured host-group identity must still work. Do not simply skip all existing delegate-cache entries, since a recognized original replication URL may need to replace metadata from an internal synthetic URL. Preserve uncached/wrapped metadata fallbacks, existing legacy behavior, and the corrected container-service scheduling.

Run the narrowest applicable formatter and relevant regression tests, including the existing MySqlReplicationTest and the new decorating-driver reproducer where feasible, and retain actual command/results as task evidence. Do not merge, create another PR, or reply to or resolve review threads. This coordinator handles review assessment and thread cleanup.

threads.body: [Javaagent] When the agent instruments `OpenTelemetryDriver.connect("jdbc:otel:postgresql://db:5432/shop", ...)`, this write overwrites the underlying PostgreSQL driver's cached `DbInfo` with the unsupported wrapper URL's `other_sql` result. Subsequent agent-instrumented queries using that delegate lose their PostgreSQL identity and database namespace. Normalize the wrapper prefix before propagating the result, or preserve valid delegate metadata when the wrapper URL is unrecognized, and add a nested-driver regression test.

replies.body: We discussed this decorator case and deliberately chose not to handle it in this PR. The guard and regression test were removed in c1e2800d to keep the MySQL fix focused. We'll revisit that compatibility handling if it is reported in practice.
